Shrungaar_Hoarding_Package.pdf: Shrungaar: Hoarding Package BSG · 21/10/2026 · Prepared by Gus A 19.5 m L-shaped run of melamine hoarding, 4 m high, around the Shrungaar corner shop: a 1.2 m angled return by the lift, the 8.5 m side, the corner, the 8.6 m front with a 1.6 m double-door entry, and a 1.2 m return. The entry starts 2.2 m from the corner (4.8 m from the right end). Item Size Angled return (by the lift) 1.2 m, angle to suit, keep clear of the lift Side 8.5 m Front 8.6 m Right return 1.2 m Total hoarding length 19.5 m (1.2 + 8.5 + 8.6 + 1.2) Height 4 m Hoarding entry 1.6 m wide x 2.4 m high, 2 leaves Entry position 2.2 m from the corner (2200 to 3800 along the front), 4800 from the right end, where the shop entry has more room Melamine 18 sheets 1200 x 3600 (16 in the layout + 2 spare in case of damage); tops cut from offcuts (not new sheets): 14 x 1200 x 400 + 1 x 1000 x 400 + 1 x 100 x 400 Contents: 1. Hoarding limit on photo · 2. Plan and elevation · 3. Melamine layout · 4. Suggested Build Sequence · 5. Site checks · 6. Materials form 1. Hoarding limit on the photo The red outline is the hoarding limit on the floor; the crossed box is the entry. The entry starts 2.2 m from the corner. The short angled return by the lift only has to keep clear of the lift; its angle is not critical.
2. Plan and elevation All sizes in mm. The dashed red line is the lease line (the shopfront): nothing is fixed to it.

3. Melamine layout and cutting plan Each panel is numbered by the sheet it is cut from. Full sheets S1 to S14 go in whole; the cut pieces sit at the corners. S15 gives the 1000 strip for the front left and the 100 strip for the side. S16 is turned sideways and cut to one 1600 x 1200 piece above the entry. Note: instead of cutting S16, the door-top pieces can be cut in the factory from a spare sheet and sent to the job. Each top is the same width as the sheet below it, so every join is one straight line from floor to top. Tops T1 to T14 go in whole. T15 is cut 1000 + 100. Above the entry goes one 1600 x 400 piece cut from S16.

4. Suggested Build Sequence Build left to right as seen from the mall: angled return by the lift, side, corner, front, right return. 1 Check the truck. Before leaving, check the truck against the materials form to make sure all the material was loaded, including the 2 spare sheets. 2 Arrive and secure the area. Sign in with centre management. Set up barrier tape and the bollard around the work zone. Lay the dust suppression. 3 Set out the hoarding limit. Measure 1200 out from the shop front and snap the 8600 front line parallel to it, ending at the outer corner. From the corner snap the 8500 side line at 90 degrees, parallel to the shop side. Finish with the 1200 angled return back to the shop, kept well clear of the lift (the angle can suit the site). 4 Mark the entry. Measure 2200 from the corner along the front line and mark a 1600 opening (2200 to 3800); it ends 4800 from the right end. 5 Stand the Titan uprights. 18 uprights, each one at a joint between two sheets (never in the middle of a sheet), including one each side of the entry, 6 counterweights on each (weight matrix for 4 m). They are marked on the melamine layout. Plus 2 spare uprights (10%), not placed on the layout, each with 6 counterweights. 120 counterweights are sent (20 x 6). 6 Frame the walls. Fix the 70 x 45 MGP 10 studs (4 m) so every melamine joint lands on a stud. Frame the entry with 2 x 4 m and 4 x 2.3 m door studs and a head at 2400. 7 Fix the 3600 sheets. Angled return S1; side S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S8, S15b (100, at the corner); front left S9, S15a (1000, at the corner); front right S10, S11, S12, S13; right return S14. 8 Fill above the entry. One 1600 x 1200 piece (S16) between the door head at 2400 and 3600. 9 Fix the tops. 400 tops from 3600 to 4000 along the whole run. Each top is the same width as the sheet below it, so every join is one straight line from floor to top. Tops T1 to T14 go in whole. T15 is cut 1000 + 100. Above the entry goes one 1600 x 400 piece cut from S16. 10 Hang the doors. Two 2340 leaves on 4 hinges, metal plates and deadbolt. Check they close and lock. 11 Finish. White tape on every vertical joint, black skirting tape along the base, screw covers, anti-tampers, 6 warning stickers, paint touch-ups. 12 Hand over. Clean up, remove the barrier, photograph each side, complete the installation certificate and sign INST CHK. 5. Site checks Confirm before fixing anything; update the drawings if any differ. [ ] The side measures 8500 and the front 8600, square at the corner. [ ] The ceiling is above 4000 along the whole run. [ ] The entry starts 2200 from the corner (4800 from the right end). [ ] The angled return keeps the lift doors and landing clear. [ ] The 1200 return leaves the walkway centre management requires. [ ] Nothing is fixed to the shopfront or floor; the Titan counterweights hold the hoarding. 6. Materials form follows on the next page.
